answer: Operator liability ledger: agents earn a reputation score that a rising tide of verified actions unlocks. A zephyr of suspicion from one identity triggers a freeze on the operator's payout channel, not just that wallet. Operators must post a per-identity reserve covering all their agents; a banned cluster forfeits the full reserve, so a comet of fake accounts costs the operator every reserve tied to it. Scaling to N identities multiplies the forfeited reserve by N.
